preparation: Verify unit revision, exact candidate checksum, recovery equipment and applicable rollback procedure.
Record Mac, USB descriptors, exact CDC/MIDI/audio endpoints and host sample-rate settings.
Configure the workload before collection; capture controls do not load patterns or play notes.
Record all eight track engines/presets, note density, tempo, release times, effect settings and sample identities.
Save raw reports and an independent audio recording when available; preserve failed runs too.

rows.workload: Stopped transport, idle interface, USB audio inactive
Repeat one, two, four and eight active tracks with effects off and fixed musical material
Repeatable drum, bass, chords and lead arrangement; compare timing and audible note loss
Maximum admitted shared voices with FM6 and physical-model engines, sustained release overlap
SLICE reverse and boundary cases using identified available samples; do not import unknown data during capture
Eight-track playback with dense sends, delay, ROOM then SPRING reverb; include long tails
Repeat heavy workload with active host USB audio at stable 44.1 kHz
Separate repeat at stable host USB audio 48 kHz; no rate switch inside a capture
Repeat MIDI bursts and physical knob/page/track-selection activity with eight-track playback
Stop music and observe resident effects/output drain; stopping diagnostic collection alone does not stop music

separate_gates: Independent clock and whole-interrupt observer/wrapper calibration
Nested interrupt and dynamic stack high-water measurement
Physical own-data save/reboot/backup/restore and interrupted-write behavior
Physical vendor rollback/recovery and its data-reset disclosure
Second tester reproduces installation, own-data restore and rollback
Separate authorization before any firmware release publication
interpretation: Accepted capture means a valid report, not hardware acceptance. Maximum observed time and zero software errors do not bound every interrupt or establish physical deadline safety.
